Question 2
?

Given the statement P:0 is not greater than 0.1 which of the following represents ¬P?

a
0 is equal to 0.1.
b
0.1 is not greater than 0.
c
0 is not greater than 0.1.
d
0 is greater than 0.1.
e
0.1 is greater than 0.
